ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle C = 90^\circ$, $\angle B = 30^\circ$, and $AB = 8$, what is the length of $BC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} In right triangle $\triangle ABC$, we have $\cos B = \frac{BC}{AB}$. \\
Thus, $BC = AB \cdot \cos B = 8 \times \cos 30^\circ = 8 \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \boxed{4\sqrt{3}}$.
